name.zh: 宇树 G1 · 23 自由度 · Mode 10

limitations.zh: 仅核验官方描述文件的关节树与外观资源；未核验内部电路、电机内部、维修拆装顺序或实机精度。 Mode 10：12 个腿部、1 个腰部、10 个手臂主动关节，不含主动灵巧手；官方 README 标为 Up-to-date。仅核验此配置，不等同于 29/31 自由度型号。尚无匹配 Mode 10 MJCF 或已运行控制器。

Mode 10 has 12 leg, 1 waist and 10 arm actuated joints, excluding active dexterous hands. The pinned README marks it Up-to-date. This is not a 29/31-DOF variant; no matching Mode 10 MJCF or running controller is verified.

name.zh: SO-101 follower · 基础开放硬件

description.zh: SO-101 五轴机械臂与旋转夹爪，用于学习有公开 CAD 与装配文字证据的基础硬件。不是主流工业机型内部结构替代品。
description.en: SO-101 five-axis arm with revolute gripper for foundational open-hardware study backed by public CAD and assembly text. Not a substitute for industrial robot internals.

verifiedScope.zh: 官方描述模型、CAD/打印件与装配文字出处
verifiedScope.en: Official description, CAD/print files and assembly-text provenance

limitations.zh: 官方已移除基座碰撞网格；这里验证外观、运动学及官方装配文字出处，不代表实机装配验证、碰撞安全或电气仿真。 基础开放硬件 SO-101 follower，新校准零位；不是 SO-100 或 leader。五个臂关节加一个旋转夹爪，非 LeRobot 0–100 归一化夹爪接口。未运行串口、电机、校准或控制代码。
limitations.en: Upstream removed base collision meshes. Visual geometry, kinematics and assembly-text provenance only; no physical assembly validation, collision safety or electrical simulation. Foundational open-hardware SO-101 follower, new-calibration zero; not SO-100 or leader. Five arm joints plus a revolute gripper, not the LeRobot normalized 0–100 gripper interface. No serial, motor, calibration or control code executed.

supportStatus.zh: 基础开放硬件 SO-101 follower，新校准零位；不是 SO-100 或 leader。五个臂关节加一个旋转夹爪，非 LeRobot 0–100 归一化夹爪接口。未运行串口、电机、校准或控制代码。
supportStatus.en: Foundational open-hardware SO-101 follower, new-calibration zero; not SO-100 or leader. Five arm joints plus a revolute gripper, not the LeRobot normalized 0–100 gripper interface. No serial, motor, calibration or control code executed.
